stage: interface patch v3: the four confirmed defects of the v2 wiring are fixed
base: f703f132 (origin/main, after the LunaFAST breadcrumb stage) + my branch; the patch touches only shared files
supersedes: evidence/STUDIO/b20-deepseek-ai-13/2026-10-10-consolidated-wiring (v1 of the consolidated patch) and every per-stage patch of the same files

addressed.PresentationOnly search -> Reveal -> Set: the gate now sits in StudioRoot.ShowProperties: while a world is frozen NO editor is built at all, only the identity, the id and the reason are shown. Search and Reveal stay usable for inspection, and no section can build a field that writes through SetField
addressed.async PlayStart captured too late: PlayStart is captured with the campaign/world context BEFORE await CompileAsync, so the spawn cannot come from a world other than the one whose scene is launched
addressed.fallback I/O uncaught: the selector fallback catches InvalidOperationException, IOException, UnauthorizedAccessException and JsonException, so an unreadable campaign or scene file degrades to 'no confirmed choice' instead of throwing out of the selector
addressed.read-only hint lost on reload: StudioRoot.RestateWriteBlock re-states the frozen reason, and StudioWorldSection.LoadWorldAsync calls it at the end, so a preview reload, Apply or Undo cannot clear what the author sees

covers: the campaign/world context, the write gate and the frozen properties panel, the Act I-only spawn arguments and the context captured before the compile await (StudioRoot.cs, PlayPreparation.cs); the capability gate, refusals in input/Place/SculptStroke/PaintStroke/ShowImport, the honest trigger panel with the safe size guard, the scatter guard, the audio entry and the asset usage facts (StudioWorldSection.cs); the PC thread list and the schema-conformant hint path with a real preview (StudioContentSection.cs); the localized reply and condition editing (StudioDialogueSection.cs, StudioQuestSection.cs)
